info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Subscribes-v1-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Subscription API allows users to access a list of subscribed weather alerts for their specific regions. This API is designed for developers looking to integrate weather alert notifications into applications, facilitating timely updates for end-users. Typical consumers include mobile app developers, weather service providers, and emergency management organizations aiming to keep their stakeholders informed. By leveraging this API, applications can effectively manage user subscriptions and deliver real-time weather warnings.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to subscribe to various alerts. Upon subscription, users will receive notifications based on the specified alert criteria.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to subscribe to alerts. Clients should provide the necessary parameters for subscription in the JSON format. The response will indicate whether the subscription was successful or not.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning subscription details.
